bodypart.earth_human.head: Head
tooltip.earth_human.canteen: Reusable water container. Craft with a water bucket or potion to fill it.
tooltip.earth_human.filled_canteen: Reliable exploration hydration. Returns an empty canteen after drinking.
tooltip.earth_human.water_purification_t: Simplified water treatment item. v0.1 gives small hydration directly; water quality comes later.
tooltip.earth_human.oral_rehydration_sal: Basic sugar and electrolyte recovery for dehydration.
tooltip.earth_human.electrolyte_tablet: Restores a little hydration and eases fatigue after sprinting.
tooltip.earth_human.rehydration_drink: Better than plain water for Nether trips and long exploration.
tooltip.earth_human.restorative_tea: Warm drink for rain, water exposure or a short recovery stop.
tooltip.earth_human.energy_bar: Portable calorie support. Mainly reduces fatigue.
tooltip.earth_human.glucose_gel: Fast sugar support. Reduces fatigue quickly.
tooltip.earth_human.cooling_pack: Temporary cooling for high body temperature. It does not replace leaving heat sources.
tooltip.earth_human.heat_pack: Temporary warming for low body temperature. It does not replace shelter.
tooltip.earth_human.emergency_blanket: Emergency warming item for hypothermia risk.
tooltip.earth_human.clean_cloth: Base medical material for bandages, masks and disinfectant supplies.
tooltip.earth_human.simple_bandage: Temporary dressing. Treats the worst torso or limb injury; use a first aid kit for serious head injury.
tooltip.earth_human.sterile_bandage: Cleaner dressing. Treats torso or limb injuries more reliably than a simple bandage.
tooltip.earth_human.disinfectant_wipe: Medical disinfectant material. v0.1 crafting item; wound and exposure use comes later.
tooltip.earth_human.antiseptic_bottle: Bottle of antiseptic. Used for first aid kits now, wound treatment later.
tooltip.earth_human.basic_first_aid_kit: Basic first aid bundle. Treats the worst injured body part, including the head when needed.
tooltip.earth_human.cloth_mask: Basic face covering. Dust, smoke and air quality integration comes later.
tooltip.earth_human.dust_mask: Better dust protection for future mining dust and industrial smoke.
tooltip.earth_human.simple_thermometer: Right-click to measure body temperature and show whether it is in the normal range.
tooltip.earth_human.field_health_note: Right-click to open the field guide for body status, care, activity and compatibility; the guide can open the live status panel.
tooltip.earth_human.resistance_band: Right-click for resistance-band rows. Mainly trains both arms and torso.
tooltip.earth_human.training_mat: Right-click to stretch and cool down. Reduces training load and eases fatigue.
tooltip.earth_human.simple_dumbbell: Right-click for dumbbell curls. Mainly trains both arms; overtraining can strain muscles.
tooltip.earth_human.exercise_duration: Hold for about %s seconds; training load is applied on completion
message.earth_human.loaded: §a[Earth Human] v0.1.16 loaded: activity tracking, body status, inventory summary, field guide and quick care are enabled.
message.earth_human.quick_help: §7Use /earthhuman status to open the status panel, or right-click the Field Health Note. /eh status text keeps the text view.
message.earth_human.players_only: This command can only be used by a player.
message.earth_human.status.title: §e=== Earth Human / Body Status ===
message.earth_human.status.body: §cBody: worst part %s, %s%% left. Use /eh body for details.
message.earth_human.status.arcana: §aSupernatural adaptation: cultivation %s, magic %s, fasting %s, extra air +%s ticks.
message.earth_human.status.hint: §7Water and rehydration items restore hydration; standing rest, daytime naps and night sleep reduce fatigue; bandages and first aid kits treat body-part injuries.
message.earth_human.help.title: §eEarth Human v0.1.16 development build guide
message.earth_human.help.status: §7/earthhuman status: open the full status panel. /eh status text: show the text view.
message.earth_human.help.body: §7/earthhuman body: show head, torso and limbs. Vanilla hearts remain authoritative by default while body parts persist; only head_bar strictly syncs hearts to head risk.
message.earth_human.help.training: §7/eh training: show body-part training level and current load. /eh exercise squat, push_up, core and stretch test exercise actions directly; bands, dumbbells and mats also work by right-click.
message.earth_human.help.settings: §7/eh settings: open the body HUD settings page for corner, size, opacity and visibility.
message.earth_human.help.thirst: §7Hydration declines over time. Sprinting and the Nether drain it faster. Carry a filled canteen, rehydration salts or drinks.
message.earth_human.help.fatigue: §7Walking, sprinting, swimming and climbing build fatigue from actual distance; riding and elytra are lighter. Short stops do not clear continuous load; real rest, stretching and sleep lower it gradually.
message.earth_human.help.temperature: §7The Nether is hot; rain and water are cold. Heat packs, blankets and cooling packs are temporary tools; leaving the extreme environment is the real fix.
message.earth_human.help.arcana: §7With the Xuanhuan or Magic branches installed, fasting, body tempering, breath training and arcane wards automatically improve hunger pressure, fatigue, temperature stress and underwater breathing.
message.earth_human.sleep.nap_start: §bYou start a short nap. Daytime naps recover fatigue without skipping the day.
message.earth_human.training.title: §e=== Earth Human / Training Status ===
message.earth_human.training.hint: §7Using a body part slowly trains it; too much load can cause muscle strain. Actions: %s.
message.earth_human.training.too_fast: §eToo fast. Catch your breath first. Forcing reps makes strain more likely.
message.earth_human.training.disabled: §eTraining is disabled by the server. This item remains available but will not add training load.
message.earth_human.training.used_equipm: §aUsed equipment for %s: highest training load %s%%, fatigue %s%%.
message.earth_human.training.overload: §6%s has high training load. Continuing hard may cause strain. Rest, sleep or stretch to recover.
message.earth_human.training.strain: §c%s was overtrained and developed muscle strain. This is an Earth Human custom status, not only vanilla weakness/slowness.
message.earth_human.body.title: §e=== Earth Human / Body-Part Health ===
message.earth_human.body.vanilla_head: §7The default mode preserves vanilla/modded heart handling while tracking persistent body state. Only head_bar strictly syncs hearts to head risk.
message.earth_human.body.hint: §7Bandages treat the worst non-head injury; a basic first aid kit can also treat the head. Limb injuries affect movement, mining and combat.
message.earth_human.body.failed: §c%s is disabled: this will not kill you directly, but continued use or further hits can strain adjacent parts. Use a bandage or first aid kit soon.
message.earth_human.body.critical: §6%s is badly injured. More damage may disable it.
message.earth_human.body.spread.use: §cYou kept using the injured %s, and it strained %s. Use a bandage / first aid kit to stop it getting worse.
message.earth_human.body.spread.impact: §cThe impact to %s strained %s. Use a bandage / first aid kit to stop it getting worse.
message.earth_human.body.unknown_part: Unknown body part: %s. Use: head, torso, left_arm, right_arm, left_leg, right_leg.
message.earth_human.settings.opened: §aOpened Earth Human status settings for body, vitals, numbers and visual theme.
message.earth_human.care.busy: §eAnother care action is already in progress.
message.earth_human.care.missing: §eNo item in your inventory can perform %s. Compatible items can opt in through Earth Human care tags.
message.earth_human.care.started: §bStarted %s using %s. It will take about %s seconds; keep that item in your inventory.
message.earth_human.care.item_changed: §eCare cancelled because the matching item moved, ran out, or no longer matches.
message.earth_human.care.cancelled: §eThe current care action was cancelled. No item was consumed.
message.earth_human.care.no_effect: §eYou do not currently need this care action. No item was consumed.
message.earth_human.reset.done: §aYour Earth Human body status has been reset.

message.earth_human.warning.fatigue: §cYou are very fatigued. Rest, sleep, or use restorative tea / energy food.
message.earth_human.warning.cold: §bYour body temperature is low. Leave water/rain, find warmth, or use a heat pack / blanket.
message.earth_human.warning.heat: §6Your body temperature is high. Avoid hot environments, hydrate, or use a cooling pack.

screen.earth_human.guide.title: Earth Human · Field Guide
screen.earth_human.guide.body.title: Reading body status
screen.earth_human.guide.body.body: The body has six regions: head, torso, left arm, right arm, left leg and right leg. The vanilla hearts remain the compatibility path for other mods; use the body figure or the status screen for the full picture. A damaged torso or limb does not immediately kill you, but it affects related actions and continued use can spread strain to nearby regions.
screen.earth_human.guide.vitals.title: Hydration, temperature and fatigue
screen.earth_human.guide.vitals.body: Hydration falls with time, movement and heat. Rehydration drinks, oral salts and canteens restore it. Temperature responds to the Nether, rain and water; heat or cooling packs are temporary buffers. When fatigue is high, stop sprinting and mining. Standing rest, a daytime nap or night sleep can restore it.
screen.earth_human.guide.care.title: What to do after an injury
screen.earth_human.guide.care.body: Open the body status screen and choose Quick Care. Bandages prioritize the most severe non-head injury, while a first-aid kit can treat the head. Care takes time and the server checks the exact item again before consuming it. You can cancel an active care action.
screen.earth_human.guide.activity.title: Activity and training
screen.earth_human.guide.activity.body: Walking, sprinting, swimming, climbing, jumping, attacking and mining create different loads and train related regions. A short pause does not instantly clear continuous load. Overtraining can cause muscle strain; rest, stretching and suitable recovery items help.
screen.earth_human.guide.compatibility.b: The default bridge is vanilla-compatible: Minecraft remains responsible for armor, max health, healing and final results from other mods, while Earth Human records the body interpretation. Earth on Minecraft, Magic and Xuanhuan can add hydration, environment and adaptation effects through public tags and APIs; the core remains standalone without them.
screen.earth_human.status.recommend.body: Treat the serious injury first. Use a bandage or first aid from the Care tab.
screen.earth_human.status.recommend.hydr: Hydration is low. Drink soon and reduce sprinting.
screen.earth_human.status.recommend.fati: Fatigue is high. Rest, stretch, or sleep.
screen.earth_human.status.recommend.exer: Continuous exertion is high. A brief stop only helps a little; take a real rest or sleep.
screen.earth_human.status.recommend.cold: Body temperature is low. Leave the rain and use warming supplies.
screen.earth_human.status.recommend.hot: Body temperature is high. Leave the heat, hydrate, and cool down.
screen.earth_human.status.recommend.ok: Overall condition is stable. Normal exploration is reasonable.
